title: Win the early holiday via Amazon and AI search as PC costs rise
summary: Prime days hit $9.86B (+8.5%), electronics +85% (Adobe). 55% use AI in discovery (NIQ). HP launched Experience AI. Omdia: PC shipments -21% in 3Q26; DRAM shifts to servers. Surface Laptop Ultra $2,599. Adobe: holiday online $275.1B.

points.headline: Holiday demand now peaks early, and electronics lead it
points.detail: Adobe: Prime days drove $9.86B (+8.5% YoY), electronics +85% vs September; holiday online forecast $275.1B. ICSC: half fear gift costs. We should time PC deals and stock to October events.

points.headline: PC volumes are falling while memory costs push AI PC prices up
points.detail: Omdia: shipments -21% in 3Q26; DigiTimes: DRAM prioritises servers. Surface Laptop Ultra is $2,599 and Apple readies a touchscreen MacBook. We should plan pricing and premium AI configs.

points.headline: AI is a mainstream way to find products, and rivals are building for it
points.detail: NIQ: 55% use AI in discovery; Gartner: 34% would use GenAI for gifts. HP launched Experience AI; TikTok added an AI agent. Anti-bot defences block shopping agents. We should make our store agent-readable.

points.headline: Channels are diverging: TikTok Shop, retail media and Amazon's own devices
points.detail: Marketplace Pulse: TikTok Shop sells and rewards differently than Amazon. Circana: Best Buy retail media reach exceeds clicks. Amazon launched Android tablets. We should tailor assortment and ad measurement per channel.

points.headline: Small businesses and AI power users are buyers worth targeting
points.detail: PYMNTS: AI power users spend like small businesses; Capital One: SMBs are confident about growth. 47% of abandoners wanted a digital wallet. We should aim device offers and wallet options at them.
